description: Source code for a service management module in a UBUS-based embedded system, involving service registration, loading from JSON configuration files, service listing, and path matching.

methods.name: void add_service_to_list(const char * name,int service_proto,service_object_t * objects,size_t count,bool is_unified)
methods.description: Adds a service entry to the global list of registered services, initializing its name, protocol, objects, and flags.

methods.name: int load_service_from_file(struct ubus_context * ubus_ctx,const char * filename,const char * file_path)
methods.description: Loads a service configuration from a JSON file, parses its contents, and registers it if enabled.

methods.name: int filter(const struct dirent * entry)
methods.description: Filters directory entries to exclude hidden files.

methods.name: int compare(const struct dirent ** a,const struct dirent ** b)
methods.description: Comparator function to sort directory entries by length and lexicographically.

methods.name: int register_services(struct ubus_context * ubus_ctx)
methods.description: Scans a directory for service config files, loads and registers each service.

methods.name: void unregister_services(void)
methods.description: Cleans up and deregisters all registered services.

methods.name: void list_registered_services(struct blob_buf * bb)
methods.description: Serializes the list of registered services into a blob buffer for external use.

methods.name: bool is_path_match(const char * requested_path,unsigned int requested_proto,service_entry_t * service)
methods.description: Determines if a requested path and protocol match any of the service's objects.

methods.name: char * get_ubus_object_name(const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves the service name associated with a given path, if it matches.

methods.name: void reference_data_callback(struct ubus_request * req,int type,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Callback invoked to parse data from a ubus reply.

methods.name: char * get_reference_data(const char * path,const char * method_name)
methods.description: Fetches reference data via ubus call based on path and method name.
